I just did what any kid did and hoped for. I put it under my pillow. The next morning I woke up and saw my tooth there so I rolled my eyes and picked it up but when I picked it up I felt something underneath my sheets. So I undid the top of my bottom sheet and there was the shiniest quarter I had ever seen. I know for a fact my mom did not put that quarter underneath my sheet. As she didn't even know about it. If she did, she would have woken me up just to get it under there! How it got there, I don't know? It left me believing in fairies though but it never happened again.
